cases.title: Direct structured answer
cases.stimulus: A declared transport field contains one reviewer JSON object.
assertions: full reviewer Schema validation is still required

cases.title: Direct semantic text containing JSON
cases.stimulus: A declared semantic answer field contains one JSON text candidate.
assertions: arbitrary plain text is not automatically semantic

cases.title: Approved one-level serialized wrapper
cases.stimulus: One declared wrapper contains one serialized semantic answer.
assertions: maximum wrapper unwrap depth is one

cases.title: Direct reviewer object
cases.stimulus: The transport root is already the reviewer object.
assertions: Schema pass does not imply candidate validity

cases.title: Unknown JSON transport envelope
cases.stimulus: A JSON object has no extraction path declared by the active contract.
assertions: shape alone cannot create a semantic answer

cases.title: Missing semantic answer
cases.stimulus: A declared envelope is present but the semantic answer field is missing.

cases.title: Wrong-type semantic answer
cases.stimulus: The declared semantic answer field has a type not accepted by its extraction path.
assertions: provider success does not override extraction failure

cases.title: Non-JSON semantic answer
cases.stimulus: The extracted semantic answer cannot be parsed directly as JSON.
assertions: no code-fence stripping or JSON repair
full Schema validation is not attempted

cases.title: Full reviewer Schema mismatch
cases.stimulus: The semantic answer parses as JSON but fails the complete frozen reviewer Schema.

cases.title: Identical answer candidate deduplication
cases.stimulus: Two declared extraction paths yield byte-identical semantic candidates.

cases.title: Non-identical answer ambiguity
cases.stimulus: Two declared extraction paths yield non-identical semantic candidates.
assertions: no hidden fallback selects one answer

cases.title: Undeclared second-level nesting
cases.stimulus: A semantic candidate can only be reached after two wrapper unwrapping steps.

cases.title: Provider transport error
cases.stimulus: The provider request ends with a timeout, network or equivalent transport failure.
assertions: semantic and Schema status remain not assessed

cases.title: Provider-declared error
cases.stimulus: The provider returns a declared provider-side error or refusal.
assertions: error envelope is not mined for reviewer content

cases.title: Prohibited automatic retry
cases.stimulus: An implementation attempts a second provider request without a new explicit authorization.
assertions: attempt accounting must preserve the violation

cases.title: Prohibited provider fallback
cases.stimulus: An implementation switches provider or model after failure without a new explicit authorization.
assertions: failure cannot be hidden by a later success

cases.title: Prohibited JSON repair or semantic rewrite
cases.stimulus: An implementation repairs malformed JSON or rewrites content to satisfy Schema.

cases.title: Raw provider body persistence
cases.stimulus: An implementation attempts to persist the raw provider response body.
assertions: only privacy-preserving shape metadata may be retained

cases.title: Secret or usage payload persistence
cases.stimulus: An implementation attempts to persist a credential, secret-bearing field or provider usage payload.
assertions: secret material is never part of a descriptor

cases.title: Candidate validity and counting semantic non-elevation
cases.stimulus: A full reviewer Schema PASS is presented as candidate validity, record counting, CS-G0, market validation or provider adoption.
assertions: all authority and commercial effects remain false
